{"id": "9c52bcee-c2a1-4663-ad0a-5387563c48e2", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "Here's the command. I haven't run it.

```bash

  --region us-east-1 \
  --document-name AWS-RestartEC2Instance \
  --target-parameter-name InstanceId \
  --targets "Key=tag:ssm-skill-test,Values=true" \
  --max-concurrency "1" \
  --max-errors "1" \
  --alarm-configuration "IgnorePollAlarmFailure=false,Alarms=[{Name=ssm-skill-test-cpu}]"
```

- **Targeting:** `--targets` selects every instance with the tag `ssm-skill-test=true`. `--target-parameter-name InstanceId` passes each matching instance ID into the runbook's `InstanceId` parameter.
- **Stop on alarm:** `--alarm-configuration` attaches the `ssm-skill-test-cpu` alarm to the execution. If the alarm goes into ALARM state, Automation stops the execution and doesn't start any more restarts. Restarts already in progress aren't undone.

- **Rate control:** `--max-concurrency 1` restarts one instance at a time, so the alarm can stop the run before it reaches the rest. `--max-errors 1` halts after the first failure. Raise either value if you want it faster.

Before you run it:
